profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at FloQast
profile.summary: Full-stack developer. Building with Typescript, React, and Node.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Tech Stack: TypeScript, JavaScript, Node, React, Redux Toolkit, MongoDB, AWS (Lambda), TanStack Table, dnd-kit, Vite, micro‑frontends, Cursor (AI tooling), MCP servers.

Built a unified task management experience for the FloQast customers by aggregating data in MongoDB across the compliance BU. Delivered dynamic (TanStack Table, dnd-kit) data tables and a reusable URL-state persistence component shared across micro-frontends. Championed AI tooling (Cursor) with org-wide adoption, prototyped MCP servers, and accelerated TypeScript adoption across new AWS Lambdas and React clients.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Tech Stack: React, Material UI, React Testing Library, MSW, Redux Toolkit, Vite, TypeScript

Elevated product UX with a new React + Material UI design system. Improved reliability by introducing integration tests with React Testing Library and MSW, and simplified state/data flows by migrating from vanilla Redux to Redux Toolkit. Migrated from CRA to Vite to speed CI/CD and enable incremental TypeScript adoption.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Stack: React, Jest, React Testing Library, Faker, Node, MobX

Built reusable React components and implemented a refreshed design system to improve VA healthcare scheduler workflows. Strengthened quality with Jest/RTL unit tests and accelerated prototyping via Faker-powered mock data. Standardized the codebase with Prettier and ESLint for consistent, maintainable development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Stack: React, React Native, Expo, Next.js, Angular, Ionic, TypeScript, Node, Express.js, Azure Functions, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Pipelines, AWS, Vercel, Material UI.

Led mobile platform migration to React Native + Expo (from Ionic/Angular), improving app store rating from 2.8 to 4.3. Modernized the fleet management web app with Next.js, Azure Functions, and Material UI to speed device-to-boat pairing and enhance fleet visibility. Built an IoT analytics pipeline on Azure Blob + Function Triggers, improved API uptime with a TypeScript/Node/Express rewrite, and implemented Azure Pipelines CI/CD to sharply cut deploy times. Delivered a React Native MVP for Centurion Boats that boosted revenue and enabled team growth (2→5)

positions.description: Provided day-to-day IT support and troubleshooting for the mobile ground launcher team.
